articles.summary: Strong film slate drove multiple all-time summer records at Marcus Theatres Marcus Theatres® , the nation’s fourth largest theatre circuit and a division of Marcus Corporation (NYSE: MCS), announced today that it recorded its highest total revenue for the summer moviegoing season in company history, defined as the first Friday in May through Labor Day. Fueled by blockbuster hits and a diverse slate of summer releases that appealed to a wide range of audiences, summer records set at Marcus Theatres include: Highest total summer revenue in company history. Highest box office for any summer. Highest summer concession, merchandise, and food and beverage revenue of all time. Highest per capita summer admission revenue and per capita concession, merchandise, and food and beverage spend for the summer moviegoing season. Highest summer attendance since 2019. Highest premium large format screen attendance and percentage of attendance and box office for any summer. Following the carryover
articles.title: Marcus Theatres Sets More Records with Highest Summer Revenue of All Time
